channel.title: Cadence 步频 — PT Research Signal
channel.description: Daily curated physical therapy & rehab research for clinicians. AI-scored signal from 50 sources.

item.title: FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRF) Prospective Payment System (PPS) Final Rule (CMS-1845-F)
item.description: CMS has issued the Fiscal Year 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRF) Prospective Payment System (PPS) Final Rule.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Effectiveness of Combined Biopsychosocial Interventions for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis evaluating combined biopsychosocial interventions for chronic low back pain found them effective in reducing pain and functional disability in adults.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Skilled Nursing Facility PPS
item.description: CMS issued the FY 2027 Skilled Nursing Facility Prospective Payment System proposed rule, outlining updates to Medicare payment policies and rates, with comments due by June 1.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) explored the efficacy and optimal technique of hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis. The median hydrodilatation volume across studies was 28 mL (range: 8.3-200 mL).
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Beyond "Biomedical-Plus": Reclaiming the biopsychosocial model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
item.description: This commentary argues that musculoskeletal physiotherapy often implements the biopsychosocial (BPS) model as "biomedical-plus" care. It proposes that physiotherapists can achieve a more authentic BPS application through three foundational conditions: professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: 河南省人民政府办公厅关于印发河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案的通知-健康界
item.description: Henan Province, China, issued an implementation plan for establishing a long-term care insurance system, aiming to fully establish the system across the province within about three years to cover employees, retirees, flexible workers, and unemployed urban and rural residents.
item.author: 健康界

item.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
item.description: A cluster randomized clinical trial found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) for neck and/or shoulder pain was cost-effective compared to usual physiotherapy, providing superior clinical outcomes at comparable costs in 136 patients.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
item.description: An individualized swimming and education program with telehealth physiotherapy showed a trend towards reduced disability at 8 weeks for chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Virtual Reality-assisted Physiotherapeutic Training for Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that virtual reality (VR)-assisted physiotherapy significantly improved pain (SMD = 0.40), physical function (SMD = 0.37), and balance (SMD = 0.44) in patients with knee osteoarthritis compared to traditional rehabilitation.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: The RESOLVE Trial: A Stepped-Wedge, Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effects of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy on Low Back Pain Outcomes in Service Members and Veterans.
item.description: The RESOLVE trial, a multisite, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial, evaluated a combined clinical practice guideline and psychologically informed physical therapy (CPG+PIPT) strategy, finding it effective in reducing low back pain-related disability and pain in service members and veterans.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: A systematic review of current evidence on clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques in sacroiliac joint dysfunction.
item.description: This appears to be a protocol for a systematic review of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction, registered on PROSPERO with a search period through 2025.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation for chronic lateral elbow pain: a randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A randomized, double-blinded, sham-controlled trial (n=49) demonstrated mid- and long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation applied to the radial nerve, combined with exercise, for chronic lateral elbow pain in terms of pain intensity, disability, and psychological outcomes.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
item.description: A methodological study following COSMIN guidelines evaluated the Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS), finding adequate content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability, with strong agreement between in-person and video-call assessments for assessing bradykinesia components.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: In adult patients with brainstem strokes, does dysphagia rehabilitation improve health-related outcomes compared to usual care for inpatients? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
item.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (n=443 participants) explored the effectiveness of dysphagia rehabilitation on swallow function in adult inpatients with brainstem stroke, categorizing interventions into traditional swallowing therapy or device inclusion.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
item.description: This meta-epidemiological study assessed equity in telehealth physiotherapy interventions using the PROGRESS Plus framework, analyzing 94 randomized controlled trials from 2020-2023 to understand how telehealth addresses or exacerbates health disparities.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Why Reducing Therapist Burnout Should Be a Priority for Rehab Therapy Practices
item.description: This article discusses the importance of prioritizing therapist burnout reduction for rehab therapy practices to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
item.author: WebPT

item.title: Tavapadon Improves Motor Symptoms in Parkinson’s Disease: Lancet
item.description: The phase 3 TEMPO-2 trial, published in The Lancet Neurology, found that tavapadon significantly and clinically meaningfully improved motor symptoms in Parkinson’s disease patients over 27 weeks.
item.author: Medical Dialogues

item.title: Ensifentrine Improves Lung Function in Chinese Patients With COPD: Study
item.description: A new study in CHEST Journal reported that ensifentrine, a novel dual PDE3/4 inhibitor, significantly improved lung function, respiratory symptoms, and quality of life in Chinese patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
item.author: Medical Dialogues

item.title: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问-健康界
item.description: China's National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine and National Development and Reform Commission issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Revitalization and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine," emphasizing enhanced TCM rehabilitation and nursing services.
item.author: 健康界

item.title: Effects of resistance-band shoulder exercise on pain, range of motion, and functional disability in diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 28 diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis evaluated resistance-band shoulder exercises, showing effects on pain, range of motion, and functional disability.
item.author: PubMed
